gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC has big open counters in its tall a, e and s, and its curves swing outward rather than curling in. Amatic SC sits above it like a bent steel rod of handwriting, and a full page of the pair would feel loose and friendly.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Amatic SC writes in a flat, unmodulated stroke with quirky, rustic terminals that stop well short of the stem, like pen on paper. Noto Sans Telugu is the plain sans here, with a high midline and counters that stay open to the outside.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana reads as wide and generous, with big open lowercase forms and broad channels leading into every counter. And Amatic SC, drawn in one steady line with no pressure change, adds a hand-lettered wobble above it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped has bold-looking lowercase, because its bodies stand so tall, with spacious gaps where the curves end. Noto Sans Thai Looped could take a slightly modest size under Amatic SC, whose single stroke width stays rustic and quirky.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Clean, rounded and inviting, Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with lowercase bowls that look inflated. But Amatic SC, with its pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform, gives the top of the page a rustic, handmade wobble.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta reads contemporary and clean, its terminals cut back to leave big gaps under a dominant x-height. And Amatic SC, built from one width of stroke, gives the page a quirky, handwritten opening line.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic reads approachable and clean, with very little gap between x-height and cap height and open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. Amatic SC adds hand-drawn rustic charm, with no swelling in its outlines.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-vai: Amatic SC draws every letter without calligraphic modulation, so its quirky, rustic strokes look squeezed out in a single line. Noto Sans Vai sits below at a slightly smaller size, its words reading as solid blocks.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Quirky and rustic, Amatic SC makes its n arches as thick as the stems beside them. Noto Sans Vithkuqi follows with open throats in a, c, e and s and a minimal step from capital to lowercase, which keeps the handwriting from taking over.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Rustic and quirky, Amatic SC keeps a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight and terminals stopping far from the stem. Noto Sans Wancho has a hulking lowercase like thick chalk, so longer text would feel solid and confident.
